title: Atlas Battery Pack to Use 70 Samsung SDI Cells, Report Says
summary: The reported 1.3 kWh pack adds detail to Atlas’s power system as humanoid makers pursue battery swapping, fast charging and new chemistries.
points: Samsung SDI is supplying the battery cells for Boston Dynamics’ Atlas humanoid, with each robot using 70 cylindrical cells in a pack of approximately 1.3 kWh, according to The Elec .
The report offers a closer look at the power supply behind Atlas as robot manufacturers pursue different ways to keep their machines working through an industrial shift.
